$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (the slot) and how to read it.

root.$why: Figma rounds a single or end slot 10 px; the code uses the group's 8 px radius so the slot follows the group's edge. The divider (Default) and the ring stroke (Active) are the first inset shadow.

Value.$why: The character is the slot's own text.
